scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic reductions and elementary Schur inequalities supply infinite-parameter proof; a reproducible Python/SymPy script verifies algebraic identities and 68 finite supplementary comparisons. Related literature has been inspected, but independent validation and priority certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only primitive period-two orbits of the explicitly stated 3D quadratic diffeomorphism and their two-step local linear spectrum are classified for 0<delta<1. No global basin, nonlinear critical normal form, creation of invariant circles/four-cycles, or uniqueness of all attractors is asserted.
title: Exact sink wedge and two instability mechanisms for the three-dimensional Hénon two-cycle
